<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ko">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>배란일·가임기 계산 테스트 | 영핏 기술가정</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Noto+Sans+KR:wght@400;500;700;900&family=Nunito:wght@700;800;900&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  :root{
    --navy:#1e2c52;--navy-2:#2a3d6e;--gold:#f5a623;--ink:#22304f;--muted:#7a87a3;
    --bg:#f4f6fb;--card:#ffffff;--line:#e6eaf3;
    --ok:#27ad6e;--ok-bg:#e3f6ec;--no:#ec5f74;--no-bg:#fde6ea;
    --shadow:0 8px 26px rgba(30,44,82,.08);
  }
  *{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
  html{-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%}
  body{font-family:'Noto Sans KR',sans-serif;
    background:radial-gradient(1200px 500px at 50% -200px,#eaf0ff 0%,rgba(234,240,255,0) 60%),var(--bg);
    color:var(--ink);line-height:1.6;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;padding-bottom:46px;}
  .wrap{max-width:680px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 16px}
  input[type=number]::-webkit-inner-spin-button,input[type=number]::-webkit-outer-spin-button{-webkit-appearance:none;margin:0}
  input[type=number]{-moz-appearance:textfield}

  header{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--navy) 0%,var(--navy-2) 100%);
    padding:20px 16px 22px;border-bottom:4px solid var(--gold);position:relative;overflow:hidden;}
  header::after{content:"";position:absolute;right:-40px;top:-40px;width:160px;height:160px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(245,166,35,.10);}
  .head-inner{max-width:680px;margin:0 auto;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:13px;position:relative;z-index:1;flex-wrap:wrap;}
  .logo{height:40px;width:auto;filter:brightness(0) invert(1);flex-shrink:0}
  .head-text h1{color:#fff;font-size:19px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:-.4px;line-height:1.2;}
  .head-text .sub{color:#c6d0ea;font-size:12px;font-weight:500;margin-top:2px;}
  .badge{display:inline-block;margin-top:6px;background:var(--gold);color:#3a2a05;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;padding:3px 11px;border-radius:999px;}

  .card{background:var(--card);border-radius:18px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);border:1px solid var(--line);padding:22px;margin-top:18px;}

  /* ===== Start screen ===== */
  .startcard h2{font-size:20px;font-weight:900;color:var(--navy);letter-spacing:-.5px;margin-bottom:8px}
  .startcard .lead{font-size:14px;color:#4a5878;margin-bottom:18px}
  .startcard .lead b{color:var(--navy)}
  .formula{background:#f7f9fd;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:16px;margin-bottom:18px}
  .formula .ft{font-size:13px;font-weight:800;color:var(--navy);margin-bottom:10px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px}
  .frow{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:9px;font-size:13px;color:#41506f;padding:5px 0;line-height:1.5}
  .frow .k{flex-shrink:0;width:64px;font-weight:800;color:var(--navy)}
  .frow .v b{color:#c2470f;font-family:'Nunito','Noto Sans KR',sans-serif}
  .meta{display:flex;gap:10px;margin-bottom:16px}
  .meta .mbox{flex:1;text-align:center;background:#f7f9fd;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:12px 8px}
  .meta .mbox .mn{font-size:22px;font-weight:900;color:var(--navy);font-family:'Nunito',sans-serif;line-height:1.1}
  .meta .mbox .ml{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600;margin-top:3px}

  .btn{width:100%;padding:16px;border:none;border-radius:14px;background:var(--navy);color:#fff;font-family:inherit;font-size:16px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:-.3px;cursor:pointer;transition:transform .08s,background .2s;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;}
  .btn:hover{background:#16213f}.btn:active{transform:scale(.985)}
  .btn:disabled{background:#c4ccdd;cursor:not-allowed}
  .btn.gold{background:var(--gold);color:#3a2a05}.btn.gold:hover{background:#e6981a}
  .btn.ghost{background:#eef1f8;color:var(--navy)}.btn.ghost:hover{background:#e3e8f3}

  /* ===== Progress ===== */
  #quizScreen{display:none}
  .progwrap{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:20;background:rgba(244,246,251,.92);backdrop-filter:blur(6px);padding:12px 16px 10px;margin:0 -16px;}
  .progtop{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;max-width:648px;margin:0 auto 7px}
  .progtop .qn{font-size:13px;font-weight:800;color:var(--navy)}
  .progtop .qn b{color:var(--gold);font-family:'Nunito',sans-serif;font-size:15px}
  .progtop .cat{font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700;color:#fff;background:var(--navy);padding:3px 10px;border-radius:999px}
  .progbar{max-width:648px;margin:0 auto;height:8px;background:#e3e8f3;border-radius:99px;overflow:hidden}
  .progfill{height:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--navy),var(--gold));border-radius:99px;width:0;transition:width .35s ease}

  /* ===== Question ===== */
  .qcard{margin-top:16px}
  .given{background:#eef3fb;border:1px solid #d8e3f5;border-radius:14px;padding:15px 16px;margin-bottom:16px}
  .given .gt{font-size:11.5px;font-weight:800;color:#3a6bbf;letter-spacing:.3px;margin-bottom:9px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}
  .given .grow{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:5px 0;font-size:14px;border-top:1px dashed #cdd9ee}
  .given .grow:first-of-type{border-top:none}
  .given .grow .gk{color:#52608a;font-weight:600}
  .given .grow .gv{color:var(--navy);font-weight:800;font-family:'Nunito','Noto Sans KR',sans-serif;font-size:16px}
  .ask{font-size:17px;font-weight:800;color:var(--ink);line-height:1.5;margin-bottom:18px;letter-spacing:-.3px}
  .ask b{color:#c2470f}

  /* answer inputs */
  .ansbox{margin-bottom:8px}
  .ans-line{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}
  .ans-line input{width:88px;border:2px solid var(--line);border-radius:13px;padding:14px 8px;text-align:center;font-size:26px;font-family:'Nunito',sans-serif;font-weight:900;color:var(--navy);background:#fafbff;outline:none;transition:border-color .15s,background .15s}
  .ans-line input:focus{border-color:var(--gold);background:#fff}
  .ans-line input:disabled{background:#f1f3f8;color:#8a96b0}
  .ans-line .u{font-size:16px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:700}
  .ans-line .tilde{font-size:20px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:800;margin:0 2px}

  .choices{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}
  .choice{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;padding:14px 16px;border:2px solid var(--line);border-radius:13px;background:#fafbff;cursor:pointer;font-size:15px;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink);transition:all .12s;text-align:left}
  .choice:hover{border-color:#c4d0e8;background:#fff}
  .choice .ck{width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:50%;background:#eef1f8;color:var(--navy);font-weight:800;font-size:13px;display:grid;place-items:center;flex-shrink:0;font-family:'Nunito',sans-serif}
  .choice.sel{border-color:var(--navy);background:#eef3fb}
  .choice.sel .ck{background:var(--navy);color:#fff}
  .choice.correct{border-color:var(--ok);background:var(--ok-bg)}
  .choice.correct .ck{background:var(--ok);color:#fff}
  .choice.wrong{border-color:var(--no);background:var(--no-bg)}
  .choice.wrong .ck{background:var(--no);color:#fff}
  .choice:disabled{cursor:default}

  /* feedback */
  .feedback{display:none;margin-top:16px;border-radius:14px;padding:16px 17px;animation:pop .25s ease}
  @keyframes pop{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(6px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
  .feedback.show{display:block}
  .feedback.ok{background:var(--ok-bg);border:1px solid #b6e6cc}
  .feedback.no{background:var(--no-bg);border:1px solid #f6c6cf}
  .fbhead{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:16px;font-weight:900;margin-bottom:8px}
  .feedback.ok .fbhead{color:#1c8a55}.feedback.no .fbhead{color:#c23a52}
  .fbans{font-size:14px;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink);margin-bottom:9px}
  .fbans .corr{color:var(--ok);font-weight:900}
  .fbexp{font-size:13px;color:#52608a;line-height:1.6;border-top:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.06);padding-top:9px}
  .fbexp b{color:var(--navy)}

  .qbtns{margin-top:16px}

  /* ===== Result ===== */
  #resultScreen{display:none}
  .gradecard{text-align:center;padding:30px 22px}
  .gcircle{width:128px;height:128px;border-radius:50%;margin:0 auto 16px;display:grid;place-items:center;position:relative;
    background:conic-gradient(var(--gold) var(--deg,0deg),#eef1f8 0deg);}
  .gcircle .gin{width:104px;height:104px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;display:grid;place-items:center;flex-direction:column}
  .gcircle .gl{font-size:46px;font-weight:900;color:var(--navy);font-family:'Nunito',sans-serif;line-height:1}
  .gradecard .gscore{font-size:17px;font-weight:800;color:var(--navy);margin-bottom:4px}
  .gradecard .gscore b{color:var(--gold);font-family:'Nunito',sans-serif;font-size:22px}
  .gradecard .gmsg{font-size:14px;color:#52608a;margin-bottom:4px}

  .reviewt{font-size:15px;font-weight:900;color:var(--navy);margin-bottom:12px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px}
  .rvitem{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:13px;margin-bottom:9px;overflow:hidden}
  .rvhead{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;padding:13px 15px;cursor:pointer;background:#fff}
  .rvhead .rvi{width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:8px;display:grid;place-items:center;font-weight:900;font-size:14px;flex-shrink:0;color:#fff;font-family:'Nunito',sans-serif}
  .rvhead.ok .rvi{background:var(--ok)}.rvhead.no .rvi{background:var(--no)}
  .rvhead .rvcat{flex:1;font-size:13.5px;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink)}
  .rvhead .rvmark{font-size:13px;font-weight:800}
  .rvhead.ok .rvmark{color:var(--ok)}.rvhead.no .rvmark{color:var(--no)}
  .rvhead .arr{color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;transition:transform .2s}
  .rvitem.open .arr{transform:rotate(180deg)}
  .rvbody{display:none;padding:0 15px 15px;font-size:13px;color:#52608a;line-height:1.6}
  .rvitem.open .rvbody{display:block}
  .rvbody .rvq{color:var(--ink);font-weight:600;margin-bottom:8px;padding-top:4px}
  .rvbody .rvrow{display:flex;gap:8px;margin-bottom:4px;font-size:12.5px}
  .rvbody .rvrow .rk{color:var(--muted);width:64px;flex-shrink:0;font-weight:600}
  .rvbody .rvrow .corr{color:var(--ok);font-weight:800}
  .rvbody .rvrow .yours{font-weight:700}
  .rvbody .rvrow .yours.bad{color:var(--no)}
  .rvbody .rvexp{border-top:1px dashed var(--line);margin-top:8px;padding-top:8px}
  .rvbody .rvexp b{color:var(--navy)}

  .resbtns{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;margin-top:18px}

  .tip{background:#fff8ee;border:1px solid #fde3bf;border-radius:13px;padding:13px 16px;margin-top:16px;font-size:12.5px;color:#7a5a1e;line-height:1.6}
  .tip b{color:#9a6a10}

  footer{text-align:center;margin-top:24px;padding:0 16px}
  footer .ft{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.7}
  footer .ftbrand{font-weight:800;color:var(--navy)}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<header>
  <div class="head-inner">
    <img class="logo" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="영핏 EngFit">
    <div class="head-text">
      <h1>배란일·가임기 계산 테스트</h1>
      <div class="sub">날짜를 직접 계산해서 답을 입력하는 연습 테스트</div>
      <span class="badge">기술가정 · 반정욱 학생</span>
    </div>
  </div>
</header>

<div class="wrap">

  <!-- ===== START ===== -->
  <section id="startScreen">
    <div class="card startcard">
      <h2>🥚 시험 대비 계산 테스트</h2>
      <p class="lead">문제에 주어진 <b>생리 주기·생리 기간·생리 시작일</b>로 <b>배란일, 가임기, 다음 생리 예정일</b>을 직접 계산해 숫자로 입력하세요. 매번 <b>새로운 문제</b>가 나와 반복 연습할 수 있어요.</p>

      <div class="formula">
        <div class="ft">📐 계산 공식 (외워두세요!)</div>
        <div class="frow"><span class="k">배란일</span><span class="v">생리 주기 − 14 = <b>?일째</b> (시작일이 1일째)</span></div>
        <div class="frow"><span class="k">가임기</span><span class="v">배란일 <b>−5일 ~ +1일</b> (정자 5일·난자 1일 생존)</span></div>
        <div class="frow"><span class="k">다음 생리</span><span class="v">생리 시작일 <b>+ 주기(일수)</b></span></div>
        <div class="frow"><span class="k">생리 끝날</span><span class="v">생리 시작일 <b>+ (생리 기간 − 1)</b></span></div>
      </div>

      <div class="meta">
        <div class="mbox"><div class="mn">8</div><div class="ml">문항</div></div>
        <div class="mbox"><div class="mn">∞</div><div class="ml">새 문제 생성</div></div>
        <div class="mbox"><div class="mn">S~F</div><div class="ml">등급 평가</div></div>
      </div>

      <button class="btn" id="startBtn">✏️ 테스트 시작하기</button>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- ===== QUIZ ===== -->
  <section id="quizScreen">
    <div class="progwrap">
      <div class="progtop">
        <div class="qn">문제 <b id="curN">1</b> / 8</div>
        <div class="cat" id="catBadge">계산</div>
      </div>
      <div class="progbar"><div class="progfill" id="progFill"></div></div>
    </div>

    <div class="card qcard">
      <div class="given" id="givenBox"></div>
      <div class="ask" id="askText"></div>
      <div class="ansbox" id="ansBox"></div>

      <div class="feedback" id="feedback">
        <div class="fbhead" id="fbHead"></div>
        <div class="fbans" id="fbAns"></div>
        <div class="fbexp" id="fbExp"></div>
      </div>

      <div class="qbtns">
        <button class="btn" id="submitBtn" disabled>정답 확인</button>
        <button class="btn gold" id="nextBtn" style="display:none">다음 문제 →</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- ===== RESULT ===== -->
  <section id="resultScreen">
    <div class="card gradecard">
      <div class="gcircle" id="gCircle"><div class="gin"><div class="gl" id="gLetter">A</div></div></div>
      <div class="gscore">총 <b id="rScore">0</b> / 8 문제 정답</div>
      <div class="gmsg" id="rMsg"></div>
    </div>

    <div class="card">
      <div class="reviewt">📋 문제별 결과 <span style="font-size:11.5px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600">(눌러서 풀이 보기)</span></div>
      <div id="reviewList"></div>
    </div>

    <div class="card" style="padding:18px">
      <div class="resbtns">
        <button class="btn gold" id="retryBtn">🔄 새 문제로 다시 풀기</button>
        <button class="btn ghost" id="homeBtn">처음 화면으로</button>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="tip">💡 <b>학습 팁:</b> 배란일은 '생리 기간'이 아니라 <b>생리 주기</b>로 계산해요(주기 − 14). 날짜를 셀 때는 <b>생리 시작일을 1일째</b>로 두고 더하면 정확합니다.</div>
  </section>

  <footer>
    <p class="ft"><span class="ftbrand">영핏 EngFit</span> · 기술가정 학습자료<br>생명의 시작과 생식의 원리를 이해하기 위한 교육용 테스트입니다.</p>
  </footer>

</div>

<script>
/* ===== helpers ===== */
const DOW=['일','월','화','수','목','금','토'];
const YEAR=2026;
function rand(a,b){return Math.floor(Math.random()*(b-a+1))+a;}
function pick(a){return a[rand(0,a.length-1)];}
function addDays(d,n){const x=new Date(d);x.setDate(x.getDate()+n);return x;}
function M(d){return d.getMonth()+1;}
function D(d){return d.getDate();}
function val(id){return document.getElementById(id).value;}

/* ===== scenario + question builders ===== */
function scenario(){
  const cycle=rand(26,32);
  const period=rand(3,7);
  const sm=rand(1,11), sd=rand(1,25);
  const start=new Date(YEAR,sm-1,sd);
  const ovDay=cycle-14;
  const ov=addDays(start,ovDay-1);
  const next=addDays(start,cycle);
  const pend=addDays(start,period-1);
  return {cycle,period,sm,sd,start,ovDay,ov,next,pend};
}
function givenHTML(s,opt){
  let rows=`<div class="grow"><span class="gk">마지막 생리 시작일</span><span class="gv">${s.sm}월 ${s.sd}일</span></div>`+
           `<div class="grow"><span class="gk">생리 주기</span><span class="gv">${s.cycle}일</span></div>`+
           `<div class="grow"><span class="gk">생리 기간</span><span class="gv">${s.period}일</span></div>`;
  return rows;
}

function qOvDayN(){
  const s=scenario();
  return {type:'dayN',cat:'배란일 계산',given:givenHTML(s),
    ask:`이 사람의 <b>배란일</b>은 생리 시작 후 <b>며칠째</b>일까요?`,
    ans:s.ovDay,
    exp:`배란일 = 생리 주기 − 14 = <b>${s.cycle} − 14 = ${s.ovDay}일째</b>입니다. (생리 기간 ${s.period}일은 배란일 계산에 쓰지 않아요!)`};
}
function qOvDate(){
  const s=scenario();
  return {type:'date',cat:'배란 예정일',given:givenHTML(s),
    ask:`이 사람의 <b>배란 예정일</b>은 며칠일까요?`,
    aMon:M(s.ov),aDay:D(s.ov),
    exp:`배란일은 <b>주기 − 14 = ${s.ovDay}일째</b>예요. 생리 시작일(${s.sm}월 ${s.sd}일)을 1일째로 세어 ${s.ovDay}일째 되는 날 → <b>${M(s.ov)}월 ${D(s.ov)}일</b>`};
}
function qNextDate(){
  const s=scenario();
  return {type:'date',cat:'다음 생리 예정일',given:givenHTML(s),
    ask:`이 사람의 <b>다음 생리 예정일</b>은 며칠일까요?`,
    aMon:M(s.next),aDay:D(s.next),
    exp:`다음 생리 예정일 = 생리 시작일 + 주기 = ${s.sm}월 ${s.sd}일 + ${s.cycle}일 → <b>${M(s.next)}월 ${D(s.next)}일</b>`};
}
function qPeriodEnd(){
  const s=scenario();
  return {type:'date',cat:'생리 종료일',given:givenHTML(s),
    ask:`이번 <b>생리가 끝나는 날</b>(마지막 날)은 며칠일까요?`,
    aMon:M(s.pend),aDay:D(s.pend),
    exp:`생리 마지막 날 = 시작일 + (생리 기간 − 1) = ${s.sm}월 ${s.sd}일 + ${s.period-1}일 → <b>${M(s.pend)}월 ${D(s.pend)}일</b>`};
}
function qFertileRange(){
  const s=scenario();
  return {type:'range',cat:'가임기 계산',given:givenHTML(s),
    aS:s.ovDay-5,aE:s.ovDay+1,
    ask:`이 사람의 <b>가임기</b>는 생리 시작 후 <b>며칠째 ~ 며칠째</b>일까요?`,
    exp:`가임기는 배란일(<b>${s.ovDay}일째</b>) 기준 앞 5일 ~ 뒤 1일이에요. → <b>${s.ovDay}−5 = ${s.ovDay-5}일째 ~ ${s.ovDay}+1 = ${s.ovDay+1}일째</b>`};
}
function qConcept(){
  const pool=[
    {ask:`배란은 일반적으로 <b>다음 생리 시작 며칠 전</b>에 일어날까요?`,opts:['약 7일 전','약 14일 전','약 21일 전','생리 첫날'],ans:1,
     exp:`배란일은 보통 다음 생리 시작 <b>약 14일 전</b>에 일어나요. 그래서 "주기 − 14"로 배란일(며칠째)을 구합니다.`},
    {ask:`배란된 난자가 살아 있는 시간은 약 얼마일까요?`,opts:['약 1시간','약 24시간(하루)','약 7일','약 한 달'],ans:1,
     exp:`배란된 난자의 수명은 <b>약 24시간(하루)</b>이에요. 정자는 약 5일까지 살 수 있어 가임기는 배란일 앞뒤로 잡습니다.`},
    {ask:`생리 주기에서 <b>"1일째"</b>는 어느 날일까요?`,opts:['배란하는 날','생리가 시작된 날','생리가 끝난 날','다음 생리 전날'],ans:1,
     exp:`생리 주기는 <b>생리(월경)가 시작된 날</b>을 1일째로 셉니다.`},
    {ask:`생리 주기가 <b>30일</b>인 사람의 배란일은 며칠째일까요?`,opts:['12일째','14일째','16일째','30일째'],ans:2,
     exp:`주기 − 14 = 30 − 14 = <b>16일째</b>가 배란일입니다.`}
  ];
  const p=pick(pool);
  return {type:'choice',cat:'개념 확인',given:'',ask:p.ask,opts:p.opts,ans:p.ans,exp:p.exp};
}

/* ===== build quiz ===== */
let QS=[],cur=0,results=[],selChoice=-1,locked=false;
const TOTAL=8;
function buildQuiz(){
  QS=[ qConcept(), qOvDayN(), qOvDate(), qNextDate(), qFertileRange(), qOvDate(), qPeriodEnd(), qNextDate() ];
  cur=0;results=[];
}

/* ===== render question ===== */
function renderQuestion(){
  const q=QS[cur];
  selChoice=-1;locked=false;
  document.getElementById('curN').textContent=cur+1;
  document.getElementById('catBadge').textContent=q.cat;
  document.getElementById('progFill').style.width=((cur)/TOTAL*100)+'%';

  const gb=document.getElementById('givenBox');
  if(q.given){gb.style.display='';gb.innerHTML='<div class="gt">📌 주어진 정보</div>'+q.given;}
  else{gb.style.display='none';}

  document.getElementById('askText').innerHTML=q.ask;

  const ab=document.getElementById('ansBox');
  if(q.type==='date'){
    ab.innerHTML=`<div class="ans-line">
      <input type="number" id="inMon" placeholder="월" inputmode="numeric"><span class="u">월</span>
      <input type="number" id="inDay" placeholder="일" inputmode="numeric"><span class="u">일</span></div>`;
  }else if(q.type==='dayN'){
    ab.innerHTML=`<div class="ans-line"><input type="number" id="inDay" placeholder="?" inputmode="numeric"><span class="u">일째</span></div>`;
  }else if(q.type==='range'){
    ab.innerHTML=`<div class="ans-line">
      <input type="number" id="inS" placeholder="?" inputmode="numeric"><span class="u">일째</span>
      <span class="tilde">~</span>
      <input type="number" id="inE" placeholder="?" inputmode="numeric"><span class="u">일째</span></div>`;
  }else if(q.type==='choice'){
    ab.innerHTML='<div class="choices">'+q.opts.map((o,i)=>
      `<button class="choice" data-i="${i}"><span class="ck">${'ABCD'[i]}</span><span>${o}</span></button>`).join('')+'</div>';
    ab.querySelectorAll('.choice').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>{
      if(locked)return;
      selChoice=+b.dataset.i;
      ab.querySelectorAll('.choice').forEach(x=>x.classList.remove('sel'));
      b.classList.add('sel');
      document.getElementById('submitBtn').disabled=false;
    }));
  }
  // input listeners
  ab.querySelectorAll('input').forEach(inp=>{
    inp.addEventListener('input',checkFilled);
    inp.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Enter'&&!locked&&!document.getElementById('submitBtn').disabled)submit();});
  });

  const fb=document.getElementById('feedback');fb.className='feedback';
  document.getElementById('submitBtn').style.display='';
  document.getElementById('submitBtn').disabled=true;
  document.getElementById('nextBtn').style.display='none';
  const inFirst=ab.querySelector('input');if(inFirst)setTimeout(()=>inFirst.focus(),80);
  window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'smooth'});
}
function checkFilled(){
  const q=QS[cur];let ok=false;
  if(q.type==='date')ok=val('inMon')!==''&&val('inDay')!=='';
  else if(q.type==='dayN')ok=val('inDay')!=='';
  else if(q.type==='range')ok=val('inS')!==''&&val('inE')!=='';
  document.getElementById('submitBtn').disabled=!ok;
}

/* ===== submit ===== */
function readAnswer(q){
  if(q.type==='choice'){if(selChoice<0)return null;return {ok:selChoice===q.ans,user:q.opts[selChoice]};}
  if(q.type==='dayN'){const v=parseInt(val('inDay'),10);if(!Number.isFinite(v))return null;return {ok:v===q.ans,user:`${v}일째`};}
  if(q.type==='range'){const a=parseInt(val('inS'),10),b=parseInt(val('inE'),10);if(!Number.isFinite(a)||!Number.isFinite(b))return null;return {ok:a===q.aS&&b===q.aE,user:`${a}일째 ~ ${b}일째`};}
  if(q.type==='date'){const m=parseInt(val('inMon'),10),d=parseInt(val('inDay'),10);if(!Number.isFinite(m)||!Number.isFinite(d))return null;return {ok:m===q.aMon&&d===q.aDay,user:`${m}월 ${d}일`};}
}
function correctText(q){
  if(q.type==='choice')return q.opts[q.ans];
  if(q.type==='dayN')return `${q.ans}일째`;
  if(q.type==='range')return `${q.aS}일째 ~ ${q.aE}일째`;
  if(q.type==='date')return `${q.aMon}월 ${q.aDay}일`;
}
function submit(){
  if(locked)return;
  const q=QS[cur];
  const r=readAnswer(q);if(!r)return;
  locked=true;
  document.getElementById('submitBtn').disabled=true;
  // lock inputs
  document.querySelectorAll('#ansBox input').forEach(i=>i.disabled=true);

  if(q.type==='choice'){
    const btns=document.querySelectorAll('#ansBox .choice');
    btns.forEach((b,i)=>{b.disabled=true;
      if(i===q.ans)b.classList.add('correct');
      else if(i===selChoice)b.classList.add('wrong');
    });
  }

  results.push({correct:r.ok,cat:q.cat,ask:q.ask,corr:correctText(q),user:r.user,exp:q.exp});

  const fb=document.getElementById('feedback');
  fb.className='feedback show '+(r.ok?'ok':'no');
  document.getElementById('fbHead').innerHTML=r.ok?'⭕ 정답입니다!':'❌ 아쉬워요';
  document.getElementById('fbAns').innerHTML=r.ok
    ? `정답: <span class="corr">${correctText(q)}</span>`
    : `내 답: <b style="color:var(--no)">${r.user}</b> &nbsp;→&nbsp; 정답: <span class="corr">${correctText(q)}</span>`;
  document.getElementById('fbExp').innerHTML='💡 '+q.exp;

  document.getElementById('submitBtn').style.display='none';
  const nb=document.getElementById('nextBtn');
  nb.textContent = (cur===TOTAL-1)?'결과 보기 →':'다음 문제 →';
  nb.style.display='';

  // auto-advance on correct
  if(r.ok){
    nb.dataset.auto='1';
    setTimeout(()=>{ if(nb.dataset.auto==='1') next(); },1300);
  }
  setTimeout(()=>document.getElementById('feedback').scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'center'}),100);
}
function next(){
  document.getElementById('nextBtn').dataset.auto='0';
  cur++;
  if(cur>=TOTAL)showResults();
  else renderQuestion();
}

/* ===== results ===== */
function showResults(){
  document.getElementById('quizScreen').style.display='none';
  document.getElementById('resultScreen').style.display='block';
  const score=results.filter(r=>r.correct).length;
  const pct=score/TOTAL*100;
  let g,msg;
  if(pct>=100){g='S';msg='완벽해요! 계산 마스터 🎉';}
  else if(pct>=85){g='A';msg='아주 훌륭해요! 시험 준비 끝!';}
  else if(pct>=70){g='B';msg='잘했어요! 조금만 더 연습하면 완벽!';}
  else if(pct>=55){g='C';msg='기본은 잡았어요. 틀린 문제를 복습해 봐요.';}
  else if(pct>=40){g='D';msg='공식을 다시 보고 도전해 봐요!';}
  else{g='F';msg='괜찮아요! 공식부터 차근차근 다시 연습해요.';}

  document.getElementById('gLetter').textContent=g;
  document.getElementById('rScore').textContent=score;
  document.getElementById('rMsg').textContent=msg;
  document.getElementById('gCircle').style.setProperty('--deg',(pct*3.6)+'deg');

  const rl=document.getElementById('reviewList');
  rl.innerHTML=results.map((r,i)=>{
    const yoursBad=r.correct?'':' bad';
    const userRow=r.correct?'':`<div class="rvrow"><span class="rk">내 답</span><span class="yours${yoursBad}">${r.user}</span></div>`;
    return `<div class="rvitem">
      <div class="rvhead ${r.correct?'ok':'no'}">
        <span class="rvi">${i+1}</span>
        <span class="rvcat">${r.cat}</span>
        <span class="rvmark">${r.correct?'정답':'오답'}</span>
        <span class="arr">▼</span>
      </div>
      <div class="rvbody">
        <div class="rvq">${stripB(r.ask)}</div>
        ${userRow}
        <div class="rvrow"><span class="rk">정답</span><span class="corr">${r.corr}</span></div>
        <div class="rvexp">💡 ${r.exp}</div>
      </div></div>`;
  }).join('');
  rl.querySelectorAll('.rvhead').forEach(h=>h.addEventListener('click',()=>h.parentElement.classList.toggle('open')));
  window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'smooth'});
}
function stripB(html){return html.replace(/<\/?b>/g,'');}

/* ===== nav ===== */
document.getElementById('startBtn').addEventListener('click',()=>{
  buildQuiz();
  document.getElementById('startScreen').style.display='none';
  document.getElementById('quizScreen').style.display='block';
  renderQuestion();
});
document.getElementById('submitBtn').addEventListener('click',submit);
document.getElementById('nextBtn').addEventListener('click',next);
document.getElementById('retryBtn').addEventListener('click',()=>{
  buildQuiz();
  document.getElementById('resultScreen').style.display='none';
  document.getElementById('quizScreen').style.display='block';
  renderQuestion();
});
document.getElementById('homeBtn').addEventListener('click',()=>{
  document.getElementById('resultScreen').style.display='none';
  document.getElementById('startScreen').style.display='block';
  window.scrollTo({top:0});
});
</script>
</body>
</html>
